tested_head_scope: Committed test source and inherited implementation built without reconfiguration; final named Task 1 and Task 2 gates passed.

local_fixture.scope: Isolated local real-socket test fixture; not a recovered staging configuration or deployment inventory.

local_verification.execution_method: Existing owned CTest targets with TEST_LAUNCHER, resource locks and RUN_SERIAL preserved.

results.note: An attempted GTEST_LIST_TESTS environment flag was ignored by this gtest build; this was an actual five-case execution, not a metadata-only enumeration.

limits: A/B/C exercise both distinct signed submitting peers and a durable matching vote before competing admission; they prove that late contention preserves the first canonical winner.
D begins with two isolated processors voting their own different payout; E reorders competing admission behind an explicit durable matching vote. Both use existing delivery/restart/catchup paths.

Certified hold bootstrap uses explicit test funding UTXOs and each disconnected store's real authorized registry CID; final payout certificate CID/epoch, exact subject, quorum and full configured membership are verified on all five peers.
Pending reconstruction consumes retained complete caller-validated TaskResult data; this fixture does not rerun the processing-result validation pipeline.
Native target budgets, process ownership, runner and quorum policy are unchanged. No deployed staging membership or history was recovered.
Local tests do not establish absence of a withheld historical certificate, authenticated cross-era certificate exclusivity or complete deployed inventory.

required_evidence_per_record: Hold signed bytes/hash, output-zero outpoint, owner, token and amount
Exact old payment bytes/hash/source/nonce/slot and canonical certificate verdict
Legacy status markers distinguished from funds-moving transactions
Durable and in-memory spender/consumption evidence, recipient outputs and token balances on every replica
Private active votes/equivocation records, pending proposals/votes and certificate retry journal
Queued local payment/completion intents, reserved and confirmed nonce/hash history, unfinished jobs and complete validated results
Existing owner lifecycle disposition with old/new transaction identities, or explicit unresolved reason
escrow_and_pending_disposition.reconstruction_rule: Only known eligible uncertified local intents with retained complete validated results may be rebuilt as new signed V2 payments through existing owner lifecycle after historical-boundary acceptance. No public operator rollback/requeue command exists; inaccessible owner actions remain unresolved.
escrow_and_pending_disposition.preservation_rule: Preserve every database and canonical history; never rewrite signed old bytes, clear votes/certificates, reset nonce history or remove consumed UTXO evidence.

historical_finality_boundary.statement: A valid old transfer certificate may outlive proposal/vote retry deadlines in a different slot from V2. Exact canonical binding and local ledger duplicate rejection do not prove absence of withheld old finality or resolve unrecovered distributed history.
permitted_final_outcomes: Explicit operator acceptance of the documented historical boundary, evidence, escrow/intent dispositions and all-validator readiness at the blocking checkpoint; deployment remains separately authorized.
historical_finality_boundary.retrospective_fence: An authenticated retrospective fence requires a separate explicit protocol decision; this record introduces no cutoff, settlement registry, allowlist or quarantine policy.

missing_evidence: Complete external participating validator/submitter/passive/offline roster and node identities.
Deployed build/source/executable/configuration identities and all-validator fixed-build readiness.
Authorized external registry CID/epoch/full weighted membership and genesis-rooted update ancestry.
Consistent operator-provided read-only copies of every participating node's GlobalDB, account/nonce and UTXO stores and canonical history.
Recovered staging certificates, exact historical payment/marker bytes and all per-node hold spender/output/balance evidence.
Private durable votes and certificate retry records plus any available volatile pending proposals/votes/queues; missing volatile state cannot be reported as empty.
Complete queued payout intents and unfinished job/result inventory with every carried-forward escrow/intent disposition.
Coordinated submission-pause acknowledgements and operator acceptance of the documented historical-finality boundary.
